title: Brush Rabbit Sylvilagus bachmani (Waterhouse, 1839)
content: This comprehensive species-specific chapter covers all aspects of species’ biology, including taxonomy, distribution, genetics, morphology, life history, ecology, behavior, parasitology, human threats, and natural impacts on populations. Species conservation management and future research challenges are addressed. The chapter includes a distribution map, a photograph of the animal, its habitat, and a list of key literature.
